reference: T009 real-device lifecycle matrix of the final FE-001 candidate transport executed through the isolated lifecycle probe page on an actual iPhone under WeChat DevTools 真机调试 (LAN) against the existing isolated local probe server, with server-side peer/UA observation: 7/7 probe cases PASS covering transport data 200, HTTP 401 error typing, network failure, bounded timeout with late success isolation, owner-end cancellation with late success isolation, timeout with late HTTP error isolation, and single terminal settlement.
environment: Device: iPhone 16 (iPhone17,3), iOS 26.6.2, WeChat 8.0.80; runtime base library SDK 3.18.1 read in-app via wx.getAppBaseInfo().SDKVersion. Runtime path: WeChat DevTools cask 2.02.2609250 (app build 36.6.0) 真机调试 over LAN, not the Simulator. Probe server: Node 26.13.0 on macOS 26.6.2 arm64 listening on http://192.168.2.135:8791 (all interfaces), logging the peer address and User-Agent; phone peer 192.168.2.212, UA MicroMessenger/8.0.80 NetType/WIFI. AppID wx746a39363f67ae95. Isolated technical probe only: no backend, production service, real family data, or production credentials involved. The lifecycle probe called the existing isolated probe endpoints only (/probe-mode, synthetic /api/v1/me with synthetic UUID account/person identities, /ok-style responses); the probe bearer token was a synthetic placeholder sent only to this local probe server and is redacted as "Bearer <redacted>" in the server log. The retained server log also contains an earlier IDE Simulator pre-run at 08:13 (platform=devtools, model iPhone 12/13 (Pro), passed 4/7) kept for traceability; it is NOT used as device evidence. Device acceptance below is the 08:17 run from peer 192.168.2.212.

operations.action: Open the lifecycle probe page on the phone and run the transport data 200 case
operations.expected: The typed transport returns kind=data with status 200 through the generated MeResponse contract, one success and no fail/abort
operations.actual: PASS kind=data status=200 success=1 fail=0 abort=0; the phone session (peer 192.168.2.212) requested /probe-mode then /api/v1/me

operations.expected: A 401 is surfaced as kind=http with the generated UNAUTHENTICATED error code, not as data or a network failure

operations.action: Run the transport network failure case
operations.expected: A connection-layer failure is classified as kind=network with no success settlement

operations.action: Run timeout with a delayed successful server response (probe-mode slow 2600 ms, timeout 700 ms, observation 2900 ms)
operations.expected: The bounded timeout settles first, the task aborts, and the late success after the timeout is suppressed
operations.actual: PASS kind=timeout abort=1 lateSuccess=0 lateFail=1; observation continued past the server delay

operations.action: Run owner-end cancellation with a delayed successful response (probe-mode slow 3200 ms, cancel at 300 ms, observation 3300 ms)
operations.expected: Owner cancellation ends the owner, aborts the task, and the late success writes no stale state
operations.actual: PASS kind=cancelled ownerActive=false abort=1 lateSuccess=0 lateFail=1

operations.action: Run timeout with a delayed HTTP error response (probe-mode slow-unauthorized 2600 ms, timeout 700 ms)
operations.expected: The timeout wins and the late HTTP 401 failure does not alter the settled result

operations.action: Run the single terminal settlement case
operations.expected: Exactly one terminal settlement is delivered; success and fail are not both applied

operations.action: Read the on-screen summary and upload it to the probe server
operations.expected: The phone shows 7/7 PASS with platform/model/runtime details and the server observes the upload
operations.actual: Phone displayed passed=7 total=7 with sdk 3.18.1, platform ios, model iPhone 16<iPhone17,3>, baseUrl http://192.168.2.135:8791 and "results upload sent"; the server logged POST /results from peer 192.168.2.212 with UA MicroMessenger/8.0.80 and the same PROBE-RESULTS payload
